messages.author: cbe06beab2c3f853
messages.subject: MSstats deviation group/sample quantification and groupcomparison
parts:
I have a question regarding MSstats which I couldn’t figure out and hope you could help me out here.
I noticed that the values in the sample/group quantification table are different from the values resulting from the groupcomparison and associated plots, is this expected or are they supposed to be the same?

E.g. samples x & y both have log2 intensity values of 10 in the sample/groupquantification table but the comparison shows a log2FC of 3 and summarization in the profile plots show log2 intensities of 5 and 10.

Many thanks!
Best regards
Marc

messages.author: df9ba0266a9a081f
messages.subject: Re: MSstats deviation group/sample quantification and groupcomparison
parts:
log2FC is the difference of mean values between conditions. So, I can't say whether log2FC=3 or not based on sample x=10, sample y=10. (no information about condition and other values of samples in those conditions.)
sample/group quantification table is summarization across replicates per sample. So, I also can't say whether it is correct or ,only with these two values.

To track the values, I need more information about that specific protein (x$ProcessedData, x$RunlevelData, output of groupComparisons, sample quantification).
If the data is confidential, please send me privately.

Hope to help.
- Meena

messages.author: df9ba0266a9a081f
messages.subject: Re: MSstats deviation group/sample quantification and groupcomparison
parts:
This issue was fixed after v3.8.3.
The input for 'quantification' is the output of dataProcess function.

- Meena
